messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 28):
"""
That the details of the (Name of product) filled in above are true and correct and reflect what the policy and other documents indicate. 2. That the product complies with the various provisions of the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024 and the applicable provisions of extant IRDAI Regulations and all circulars issued by IRDAI from time to time. 3. That the application, IRDAI-HIP, and all other documents are complete and have been verified for correctness and consistency not only in respect of each item of each document but also vis-a-vis one another. 4. that the policy wordings filed along with IRDAI-HIP application is in compliance with IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024 issued thereon. 5. that the Prospectus submitted is in compliance with the applicable provisions of IRDAI Act 1999, Insurance Act, 1938, Rules, Regulations, Guidelines/Circulars issued thereunder. Date:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What must the insurer confirm about the product details in the application form?","answer":"The insurer must confirm that the details of the product are true, correct, and reflect what the policy and other documents indicate.","facts":["\"That the details of the (Name of product) filled in above are true and correct and reflect what the policy and other documents indicate.\""]},{"question":"What does the insurer need to verify regarding the application and related documents?","answer":"The insurer must verify that the application, IRDAI-HIP, and all other documents are complete and have been verified for correctness and consistency with each other.","facts":["\"That the application, IRDAI-HIP, and all other documents are complete and have been verified for correctness and consistency not only in respect of each item of each document but also vis‑a‑vis one another.\""]}]}
